rules.statement: A payment by one of several joint debtors operates as a payment to take the debt out of the Prescription Ordinance, as against all jointly liable with him.
rules.supporting_quote: "This is also clearly laid down in several cases cited in the course of the argument. In Burleigh and others v. Stott[ 1 8 B& C. 361] Lord Tenterdon C.J. in 1818 states 'Suppose the note had been joint only, there could not have been any doubt that a part-payment by one of the joint promisors would . . . . operate as an admission by all the joint promisors that the note was unsatisfied, and therefore as a promise by all to pay the residue.'"
